datasets.name: ac06a55c
queryLines:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        quarter,
        year_quarter,
        month,
        month_name,
        year_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN customer_type = 'Repeat' THEN customer_unique_id END) AS repeat_customers
    FROM asb.semantic.delivery_logistics
    GROUP BY year, quarter, year_quarter, month, month_name, year_month
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        year_month,
        SUM(gross_item_revenue) AS gross_sales,
        SUM(item_price) AS net_sales
    FROM asb.semantic.order_item_sales
    GROUP BY year_month
),
monthly_combined AS (
    SELECT 
        o.year,
        o.quarter,
        o.year_quarter,
        o.month,
        o.month_name,
        o.year_month,
        o.total_orders,
        COALESCE(s.gross_sales, 0) AS gross_sales,
        COALESCE(s.net_sales, 0) AS net_sales,
        ROUND(COALESCE(s.net_sales, 0) / NULLIF(o.total_orders, 0), 2) AS aov,
        o.unique_customers,
        ROUND((o.repeat_customers * 100.0) / NULLIF(o.unique_customers, 0), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
    FROM monthly_orders o
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales s ON o.year_month = s.year_month
)
SELECT 
    year,
    quarter,
    year_quarter,
    month,
    month_name,
    year_month,
    
    -- 1. Orders & Sales Base Metrics
    total_orders,
    gross_sales,
    net_sales,
    
    -- 2. AOV + MoM / YoY Benchmarks
    aov,
    LAG(aov, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_aov,
    LAG(aov, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_year_aov,
    ROUND(((aov - LAG(aov, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(aov, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)) * 100, 2) AS aov_mom_pct,
    ROUND(((aov - LAG(aov, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(aov, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)) * 100, 2) AS aov_yoy_pct,

    -- 3. Unique Customers + MoM / YoY Benchmarks
    unique_customers,
    LAG(unique_customers, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_unique_customers,
    LAG(unique_customers, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_year_unique_customers,
    ROUND(((unique_customers - LAG(unique_customers, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(unique_customers, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)), 2) AS unique_customers_mom_pct,
    ROUND(((unique_customers - LAG(unique_customers, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(unique_customers, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)), 2) AS unique_customers_yoy_pct,

    -- 4. Repeat Customer Rate + MoM / YoY Benchmarks
    repeat_customer_rate_pct,
    LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_month_repeat_rate_pct,
    LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_year_repeat_rate_pct,
    ROUND(((repeat_customer_rate_pct - LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 1) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_rate_mom_pct,
    ROUND(((repeat_customer_rate_pct - LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(repeat_customer_rate_pct, 12) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_rate_yoy_pct

FROM monthly_combined
ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: f24ffd44
queryLines:
SELECT 
    o.year,
    o.year_quarter,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.item_price), 0) AS net_sales,
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id), 0) AS unique_customers,
    ROUND(net_sales / unique_customers, 2) AS arpu
FROM asb.semantic.delivery_logistics o
LEFT JOIN asb.semantic.order_item_sales s 
    ON o.order_id = s.order_id
GROUP BY o.year, o.year_quarter
ORDER BY o.year, o.year_quarter

datasets.name: e817f15a
queryLines:
WITH quarterly_delivery AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        quarter,
        year_quarter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_delivered = 1 AND is_late_delivery = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_deliveries,
        SUM(is_delivered) AS delivered_orders,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_delivered = 1 AND is_late_delivery = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
            NULLIF(SUM(is_delivered), 0), 
            2
        ) AS late_delivery_rate_pct
    FROM asb.semantic.delivery_logistics
    GROUP BY year, quarter, year_quarter
),
quarterly_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        year_quarter,
        ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
    FROM asb.semantic.order_satisfaction
    GROUP BY year_quarter
)
SELECT 
    d.year,
    d.quarter,
    d.year_quarter,
    d.late_deliveries,
    d.delivered_orders,
    d.late_delivery_rate_pct,
    r.avg_review_score
FROM quarterly_delivery d
LEFT JOIN quarterly_reviews r ON d.year_quarter = r.year_quarter
ORDER BY d.year_quarter

datasets.name: a33ecfe0
queryLines:
WITH filtered_seller_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        SUM(item_price) AS seller_net_sales
    FROM asb.semantic.order_item_sales
    WHERE (:param_year = 'All' OR CAST(year AS STRING) = :param_year)
      AND (:param_year_quarter = 'All' OR CAST(year_quarter AS STRING) = :param_year_quarter)
      AND (:param_year_month = 'All' OR  CAST(year_month AS STRING) = :param_year_month)
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
ranked_sellers AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        seller_net_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seller_net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_sellers_in_period
    FROM filtered_seller_revenue
)
SELECT 
    seller_id,
    seller_net_sales,
    total_sellers_in_period,
    CASE 
        WHEN sales_rank <= CEIL(total_sellers_in_period * 0.10) THEN seller_net_sales 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS top_10_pct_sales
FROM ranked_sellers

datasets.name: 9e23d276
queryLines:
SELECT 
    CASE i.seller_state 
        WHEN 'SP' THEN 'São Paulo' 
        WHEN 'RJ' THEN 'Rio de Janeiro' 
        WHEN 'MG' THEN 'Minas Gerais' 
        WHEN 'RS' THEN 'Rio Grande do Sul' 
        WHEN 'PR' THEN 'Paraná' 
        WHEN 'SC' THEN 'Santa Catarina' 
        WHEN 'BA' THEN 'Bahia' 
        WHEN 'DF' THEN 'Distrito Federal' 
        WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Espírito Santo' 
        WHEN 'GO' THEN 'Goiás' 
        WHEN 'PE' THEN 'Pernambuco' 
        WHEN 'CE' THEN 'Ceará' 
        WHEN 'PA' THEN 'Pará' 
        WHEN 'MT' THEN 'Mato Grosso' 
        WHEN 'MA' THEN 'Maranhão' 
        WHEN 'MS' THEN 'Mato Grosso do Sul' 
        WHEN 'PB' THEN 'Paraíba' 
        WHEN 'PI' THEN 'Piauí' 
        WHEN 'RN' THEN 'Rio Grande do Norte' 
        WHEN 'AL' THEN 'Alagoas' 
        WHEN 'SE' THEN 'Sergipe' 
        WHEN 'TO' THEN 'Tocantins' 
        WHEN 'RO' THEN 'Rondônia' 
        WHEN 'AM' THEN 'Amazonas' 
        WHEN 'AC' THEN 'Acre' 
        WHEN 'AP' THEN 'Amapá' 
        WHEN 'RR' THEN 'Roraima' 
        ELSE i.seller_state 
    END AS seller_state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.seller_id) AS active_sellers, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS orders_made, 
    SUM(i.item_price) AS net_sales 
FROM asb.semantic.order_item_sales i 
LEFT JOIN asb.olist_gold.dim_sellers s 
    ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id 
WHERE (:param_year = 'All' OR CAST(i.year AS STRING) = :param_year)
  AND (:param_year_quarter = 'All' OR CAST(i.year_quarter AS STRING) = :param_year_quarter)
  AND (:param_year_month = 'All' OR CAST(i.year_month AS STRING) = :param_year_month)
GROUP BY i.seller_state
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

datasets.name: 899849ea
queryLines:
WITH order_level_reviews AS (
    -- Normalize reviews to 1 row per order_id to prevent item-level fan-out
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        AVG(review_score) AS order_review_score
    FROM asb.semantic.order_satisfaction
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_orders AS (
    -- Distinct seller-order grain so multi-item orders count once per seller
    SELECT DISTINCT
        i.year,
        i.year_quarter,
        i.year_month,
        i.month_name,
        i.seller_id,
        CASE i.seller_state
            WHEN 'SP' THEN 'São Paulo'
            WHEN 'RJ' THEN 'Rio de Janeiro'
            WHEN 'MG' THEN 'Minas Gerais'
            WHEN 'RS' THEN 'Rio Grande do Sul'
            WHEN 'PR' THEN 'Paraná'
            WHEN 'SC' THEN 'Santa Catarina'
            WHEN 'BA' THEN 'Bahia'
            WHEN 'DF' THEN 'Distrito Federal'
            WHEN 'ES' THEN 'Espírito Santo'
            WHEN 'GO' THEN 'Goiás'
            WHEN 'PE' THEN 'Pernambuco'
            WHEN 'CE' THEN 'Ceará'
            WHEN 'PA' THEN 'Pará'
            WHEN 'MT' THEN 'Mato Grosso'
            WHEN 'MA' THEN 'Maranhão'
            WHEN 'MS' THEN 'Mato Grosso do Sul'
            WHEN 'PB' THEN 'Paraíba'
            WHEN 'PI' THEN 'Piauí'
            WHEN 'RN' THEN 'Rio Grande do Norte'
            WHEN 'AL' THEN 'Alagoas'
            WHEN 'SE' THEN 'Sergipe'
            WHEN 'TO' THEN 'Tocantins'
            WHEN 'RO' THEN 'Rondônia'
            WHEN 'AM' THEN 'Amazonas'
            WHEN 'AC' THEN 'Acre'
            WHEN 'AP' THEN 'Amapá'
            WHEN 'RR' THEN 'Roraima'
            ELSE i.seller_state
        END AS seller_state_name,
        i.order_id,
        d.is_delivered,
        d.is_late_delivery,
        r.order_review_score
    FROM asb.semantic.order_item_sales i
    JOIN asb.semantic.delivery_logistics d ON i.order_id = d.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_level_reviews r ON i.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT 
    year,
    year_quarter,
    year_month,
    month_name,
    LEFT(seller_id, 5) AS seller_short_id,
    seller_id,
    seller_state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_received,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_delivered = 1 AND is_late_delivery = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(is_delivered), 0), 
        4
    ) AS late_delivery_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(order_review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM seller_orders
GROUP BY year, year_quarter, year_month, month_name, seller_id, seller_state_name
HAVING AVG(order_review_score) < 2.5
ORDER BY orders_received DESC
